keywords.title: Search Keywords
keywords.description: Job titles, skills, or stack terms (e.g. ['Machine Learning', 'Android', 'Python']).
keywords.sectionDescription: Filter jobs by keywords, locations, and remote preference.

visaSponsorshipOnly.title: Visa Sponsorship Only
visaSponsorshipOnly.description: When enabled, filters for jobs with confirmed sponsorship signals (on sponsor list, historical filings, or stated in JD).
visaSponsorshipOnly.sectionDescription: Cross-reference against official government sponsor registries and check explicit sponsorship statements.

includeUnknownVisa.title: Include Unknown Visa Status
includeUnknownVisa.description: When Visa Sponsorship Only is enabled, also include jobs where sponsorship status is unknown. Disable this for stricter sponsorship-only results.

visaRegistryCountries.title: Visa Registry Countries
visaRegistryCountries.description: Official sponsor registries to check against.

minVisaConfidence.title: Minimum Visa Confidence
minVisaConfidence.description: Minimum confidence level required for emitted jobs.
enumTitles: On Sponsor List (UK/US Official Sponsor Registry)
Stated in Job Description (Explicit sponsorship statement)

excludeExplicitNoSponsorship.title: Exclude Explicit 'No Visa' Listings
excludeExplicitNoSponsorship.description: Exclude jobs with explicit statements like 'Must already have right to work' or 'No sponsorship'.

sources.title: Data Sources
sources.description: Select public ATS systems and job boards to query.
sources.sectionDescription: Select public ATS endpoints and job board feeds.

companyUrls.title: Company Career Page URLs
companyUrls.description: Specific ATS career page URLs to scrape (e.g. ['https://boards.greenhouse.io/stripe', 'https://jobs.lever.co/figma']).

companyNames.title: Target Company Names
companyNames.description: Specific company names to search for across job feeds.

seniorityLevels.title: Seniority Levels
seniorityLevels.sectionDescription: Narrow jobs by seniority, employment type, age, and salary.

postedWithinDays.title: Posted Within Days
postedWithinDays.description: Maximum age of job postings in days.

minSalary.title: Minimum Salary
minSalary.description: Minimum annual compensation floor (jobs without listed salary are retained).

salaryCurrency.title: Salary Currency
salaryCurrency.description: ISO currency code (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP).

technologies.title: Target Technologies
technologies.description: Technologies or programming languages to require in job descriptions.

enableAIClassification.title: Enable AI Classification
enableAIClassification.description: Use LLM router (Gemini, Groq, OpenRouter) to evaluate deep technical relevance and score job match quality.
enableAIClassification.sectionDescription: AI relevance scoring, sorting, and output limits.

minimumRelevanceScore.title: Minimum AI Relevance Score
minimumRelevanceScore.description: Minimum AI score (0.0 to 1.0) required to include a job when AI classification is enabled.

maxAICalls.title: Max AI Calls Budget
maxAICalls.description: Maximum number of LLM classification calls allowed per run.

classificationPrompt.title: Custom Classification Prompt
classificationPrompt.description: Optional custom prompt guidelines for the AI classifier.

maxResults.title: Max Results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of matching jobs to output.

sortBy.title: Sort By
sortBy.description: Field to sort the output jobs by.

includeDescription.title: Include Full Description
includeDescription.description: Include full text/HTML job description in dataset output.

deduplicateWithinRun.title: Deduplicate Within Run
deduplicateWithinRun.description: Deduplicate listings within the current execution based on company, title, and location fingerprint.

maxPerSource.title: Max Jobs Per Source
maxPerSource.description: Maximum jobs to fetch from each individual ATS/board.

concurrency.title: Source Concurrency
concurrency.description: Number of concurrent sources to fetch simultaneously.

timeoutPerSourceSecs.title: Timeout Per Source (Seconds)
timeoutPerSourceSecs.description: HTTP request timeout per source in seconds.

maxRuntimeSecs.title: Max Runtime (Seconds)
maxRuntimeSecs.description: Maximum allowed runtime for the Actor before graceful termination.

enableOverseasSources.title: Enable Overseas Sources
enableOverseasSources.description: Include 248 verified overseas government portals, manpower agencies, and niche boards (India/Pakistan/Bangladesh → Gulf & beyond).
enableOverseasSources.sectionDescription: Verified government portals, manpower agencies, and niche boards for migration corridors (India/Pakistan/Bangladesh → Gulf, East Asia, Europe, Canada, Australia). Off by default; existing sources are unaffected.

overseasCategories.title: Overseas Source Categories
overseasCategories.description: Which verified overseas source categories to include.

overseasDestinationCountries.title: Overseas Destination Countries
overseasDestinationCountries.description: Keep only jobs destined for these countries (jobs with unknown destinations are always kept). Empty = all destinations.

overseasMaxSourcesPerRun.title: Max Overseas Sources Per Run
overseasMaxSourcesPerRun.description: How many overseas sources to fetch in a single run.

overseasConcurrency.title: Overseas Concurrency
overseasConcurrency.description: Concurrent overseas page fetches (per-host is further limited to 2).

overseasBudgetSecs.title: Overseas Budget (Seconds)
overseasBudgetSecs.description: Time budget for overseas fetching. When enabling overseas sources, raise maxRuntimeSecs to at least 900. The budget is automatically capped at 80% of maxRuntimeSecs.

overseasFetchDetails.title: Fetch Overseas Detail Pages
overseasFetchDetails.description: Fetch job detail pages for richer descriptions and better dedup (slower, more requests).

overseasMaxDetailFetches.title: Max Overseas Detail Fetches
overseasMaxDetailFetches.description: Maximum number of overseas detail pages to fetch per run.

overseasSimhashDedup.title: SimHash Near-Duplicate Dedup
overseasSimhashDedup.description: Remove copy-pasted duplicate job descriptions across overseas agencies using SimHash.

overseasSimhashThreshold.title: SimHash Threshold
overseasSimhashThreshold.description: Hamming distance at or below which two overseas jobs are treated as near-duplicates (lower = stricter).

overseasMinResults.title: Overseas Minimum Results
overseasMinResults.description: Guarantee at least this many overseas jobs in the output (they otherwise rank below registry-enriched jobs and can be truncated to zero). Set to 0 to disable the guarantee. Clamped to maxResults.

respectRobotsTxt.title: Respect robots.txt
respectRobotsTxt.description: Honor robots.txt rules on overseas sources before fetching.
